- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:261, 268-269 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The parser requires the handoff heading to be on `lines[0]` (the very first line of the comment body). This is a tight coupling between the workflow's comment format (review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh lines 68, 164) and the parser. If the workflow changes its format (e.g., adds a greeting line before the heading), the parser would silently reject ALL legitimate handoffs.
  WHY: The workflow's current output (`scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh` line 68/164: `echo "## Review round ${claude_fixer_round}: ..."` as the first echo) matches the parser's expectation. No immediate failure.
- Requirement: "A changelog fragment is required when the PR changes observable behavior (CLAUDE.md §20). The fragment path is changelog.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md."
  Expected change site: changelog.d/4471-checker-accepts-forged-review-handoff.md
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff does not include any changelog.d/4471-*.md file. The manifest `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` adds entries for changelog.d/4451-*, 4452-*, 4453-* but not for 4471 itself. Per CLAUDE.md §20.A, "Add exactly one fragment when the PR changes observable behaviour" — this PR changes the checker's trust boundary (new env var CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN, new header format requirement, run verification). A consumer receiving @stable will see this change. The fragment is missing.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "The CI `lint` check on head SHA 686830cf is currently failing with `test_codex_thread_reuse_core.py:567` — `AssertionError` on 'helper_path="scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh"' in text. The PR does not touch validate.yml or stage_workflow_support.sh. The failure is pre-existing on the same commit the diff was generated from."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/validate.yml (not modified by this PR)
  Evidence of absence: The 7 changed files in the PR diff are all unrelated to validate.yml or stage_workflow_support.sh. The assertion is on content that was already on the branch before this PR's changes. However, the failing required check blocks merge of this PR.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR (soft blocker — PR cannot merge while lint fails)
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
